SELECT Degree_Programs.degree_program_id, Degree_Programs.degree_summary_name
FROM Degree_Programs
JOIN (
    SELECT degree_program_id, COUNT(*) AS student_count
    FROM Student_Enrolment
    GROUP BY degree_program_id
) AS enrol_counts
ON Degree_Programs.degree_program_id = enrol_counts.degree_program_id
ORDER BY enrol_counts.student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
